name: style_sniffer
description: Sniff project code style from samples → PROJECT_RULES.md content (returns text; output dir optional).

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: absolute path of the project root to sniff style in

scope.description: Scan scope: directory relative to workspace_dir (default: ".")

output.description: Directory to write PROJECT_RULES.md into (default: none, returns content only). Will NOT overwrite an existing file unless force=true

force.description: Overwrite existing PROJECT_RULES.md when output is set (default: false)
